title: Backup & portability
subtitle: Your data is never uploaded. Backups contain courses, lessons and progress — never API keys.
moveRemote: Copy everything from this browser’s IndexedDB into the SQLite file, then keep or clear the browser copy.
moveLocal: Only available when the local server is running and its pairing token is set in Settings → My local agent.
exportCourseAfter: commands in Claude Code, OpenCode or Cursor.
backupExported: Backup exported ({n} records). API keys are never included.
noBrowserData: No browser data found to import.
importedVerified: Imported {n} records from the browser into SQLite — counts verified.
clearConfirm: Delete the browser (IndexedDB) copy? SQLite is unaffected.
cleared: Browser copy cleared. SQLite is unaffected.
exported: Exported {name} — continue it with professor:* commands.
